title: MACE-Dance: Motion-Appearance Cascaded Experts for Dance Generation
summary: A framework for music-driven dance video generation using a cascaded Mixture-of-Experts approach that decouples motion synthesis from appearance rendering. It achieves state-of-the-art results in long-sequence generation and supports zero-shot editing of character movements.
research_notes: Utilizes a BiMamba-Transformer hybrid architecture for temporal stability and handles long-duration synthesis (30s+) beyond its training window.

evolution.summary: The project was accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026, with official source code, pre-trained models, and the comprehensive MA-Data dataset released in May 2026.
